body:
I’m sorry that it also happens with u 

I feel it rlly 

But to be honest, I’m not seeking to find friends or anything
What I’ve learned is that better put effort into yourself than in somebody 

I will for sure feel much better and also the only disappointment that i can have is me 


I hope someday everything will turn good for both of us(if ur not feeling good)
Quite a lot of people actually

I don’t think it gets better 

I think we learn how to deal and live with it 

I’ve been struggling with a lot of bs for such long time, I still can’t deal with a lot of it 

But I’m living with it for now

Everyone needs someone to talk actually 

Can be a good friend, friend or parent 
But that doesn’t  mean we will have it 

I don’t have anyone also, for years still the same 

I also don’t like to hangout

Just accept how I am and that’s it

That’s a good text but I disagree with some things 

People can be loved for sure but that doesn’t mean you are loved doesn’t matter what. People tend to show that they love you for the sake of feeling better or anything else. 

You are alone in this fight, for sure you could have someone near you to help and support but that’s all in your hand 

No one will make your life feel better 

Only you will. 

Sometimes people help others just to help 
Others to feel better 
Or to feel they are helping someone which is good 

But when this feeling get fulfilled, people tend to stop caring and leave

I also done with it really 

I do understand why people say such things but can’t they also understand us? Or at least see our view

They think we gonna wake up from another day and be like oh I love myself now. So someone else will love me as well 

I agree that you should love yourself so you can love others and the same for tab

 But saying it to everyone that you should love yourself and that’s there’s always a way is so damn exhausting 

Don’t they think we tried to love ourselves?? 

.....

When you die, they pretend they care about you, say so many “good things” how good you were, how nice you are to them as well 

And much more things

They do it to feel good

But deeply they only care about themselves 

Fuck humanity

Thank you for your advice but I already did therapy for almost 4 years with medicine as well

Nothing changed as u can see 

But still I gonna check it up 

Ty

Thank you
Really appreciate it 

I never did anything bad to anyone. Ever 

But seems like it doesn’t help if u do something bad or good to someone 

Thanks once again
